The '''''Lost Secrets of the Jedi''''' was a bestselling [[Book/Legends|book]] during the [[New Republic era]]. It purported to be authentic and claimed to deal with the "secret masters" of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]; implying the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[Galactic Archives]] on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] added it to its catalog list.

During his visit to [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]] in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] bought the book at a satellite outlet in the [[Trader's Plaza]] while under the pseudonym Li Stonn; hoping to discover the whereabouts of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|his mother]]. He went to read the book at a nearby club bar called [[Jabba's Throne Room]]. The book was presumably a fraud along with the Archive's other publications including ''[[Principles of Power]]'' and a [[Sith book of offerings and rituals]].
